interface.title: Gel Profile Studio — agarose gel lane densitometry
interface.field: Molecular biology / DNA agarose gel electrophoresis
interface.stage_of_work: Analysing gel images after the run: lane densitometry, size calibration, checking fragments and exporting results
interface.what_it_is_for: A browser tool that runs entirely on the user's computer. It turns a gel photo into per-lane intensity profiles, calibrates them against a DNA ladder to estimate band sizes, quantifies bands, checks bands against expected digest/PCR fragments, and exports CSV, SVG, PNG, HTML report and project JSON.

data.note: agarose-gel-dna.jpg (858×1024 px; a UV-transilluminator photo of a gel with a 5-band ladder and 2 bright sample bands) was loaded with the hidden file input. The same file was also used as the only 'replicate' in Batch analysis. No other test files were available, so a saved project JSON could not be loaded back in. The ladder identity is unknown: the custom sizes typed in were made up, so every bp value in this record is a workflow demonstration, not a measurement.
